facts.rationale: Replaces unsupported bookkeeping-unregistration semantics with the observed call and field-write sequence.
facts.value: Performs terminal teardown of a retained item: passes its grab_victim as a fighter to conditional player-bookkeeping helpers, forwarding the release float; resets destroy_type to numeric 0 when the integer guard is nonzero; clears atk_victim and grab_victim; then invokes final cleanup and destruction unconditionally.

facts.rationale: Separates old-item and replacement-projectile lifetimes and preserves the exceptional creation-failure path and ambiguous zero result.
facts.value: The constructor copies launch attributes into a new It_Kind_Unk2, initializes deceleration and lifetime, enters state 0, and returns the maximum enabled-hitbox damage floored at zero, or zero on spawn failure. Kirby's item-spit callers forward that result to teardown of the original retained item and then clear their retained-item pointers, including when replacement creation fails. Teardown reads the old item's grab_victim for fighter bookkeeping; this is not a represented fighter stored in the new star.

evidence.why: Separate item and fighter routes and item-drink teardown.

facts.value: Implements the temporary star replacing an inhaled item in Kirby's item-spit route, plus retained-item teardown used by item spit and drink. The swallowed-fighter spit callbacks follow a separate fighter-release path rather than invoking this constructor.

evidence.why: Gameplay integration and separate fighter path.

facts.rationale: Preserves verified module behavior while removing the conflation with releasing a represented swallowed fighter.
facts.value: Implements the one-state It_Kind_Unk2 replacement star for Kirby's inhaled-item spit path: fallible construction, finite-lifetime countdown, configured XY deceleration with an x-only low-speed fallback, environment-collision completion, and stale-reference cleanup. Also supplies terminal teardown of the original retained item for Kirby's item-spit and item-drink handling.
